result.summary: The street features a continuous sidewalk on the left, though it is currently obstructed by trash bins and debris. A large portion of the foreground roadway is obscured by a digital blur, but the visible environment shows a wide street with parallel parking and a signalized intersection in the distance.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Trash bins and loose debris significantly narrow the usable sidewalk width for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb may limit visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Designated Trash Storage
interventions.description: Create specific areas or enclosures for trash bins that do not encroach on the pedestrian clear zone.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks at the intersection to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and improve visibility.

result.summary: The environment is hostile to pedestrians, lacking any dedicated walkways or crossing infrastructure. Pedestrians are forced to navigate a grassy verge or the roadway edge in an area dominated by a bridge overpass and high-speed road geometry.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: There is no paved walkway, forcing pedestrians to walk on the grass or in the travel lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the entire foreground and midground roadside

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: The bridge pillars and the steep embankment limit sightlines between drivers and pedestrians near the overpass.
hazards.location_in_image: Center background under and around the bridge structure

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant paved sidewalk along the roadway to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale lighting, particularly under the bridge overpass, to improve visibility and security.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly hostile due to the complete absence of paved sidewalks on either side of a multi-lane roadway. Pedestrians are forced to use an unpaved, uneven shoulder that is further obstructed by parked vehicles, or walk directly in the travel lanes.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalks
hazards.description: There is no paved walkway for pedestrians, forcing them onto the unpaved shoulder or into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway throughout the visible block.

hazards.name: Shoulder Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the unpaved right shoulder block the only available space for pedestrians to walk outside of the travel lanes.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image where the silver pickup truck is parked.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant paved sidewalk on at least one side of the street, preferably both, to provide safe separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Road Diet and Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes to slow vehicle speeds and create space for a protected bike lane or wider pedestrian buffer.

interventions.title: Formalize On-Street Parking
interventions.description: Define parking areas with striping or curbs to prevent vehicles from encroaching on pedestrian paths and improve sight lines.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is significantly degraded, characterized by a lack of clear separation between the roadway and the walkway. The paved area in front of the buildings is heavily obstructed by commercial merchandise and waste containers, forcing pedestrians into a poorly maintained, unpaved or severely broken roadway surface.

hazards.name: Severely degraded pavement
hazards.description: The roadway surface is unpaved or has completely failed, creating significant trip hazards and uneven surfaces for all users.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the image where vehicles are parked.

hazards.name: Sidewalk obstructions
hazards.description: Appliances and trash bins are stored directly on the paved walkway, narrowing the effective width and forcing pedestrians to deviate from their path.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image in front of the appliance store and residential building.

hazards.name: Lack of vertical separation
hazards.description: There is no curb or physical barrier separating the pedestrian walkway from the vehicle parking and travel area.
hazards.location_in_image: Transition between the paved building frontage and the dirt/gravel roadway.

interventions.title: Roadway and Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Full-depth reconstruction of the street with a clearly defined, paved roadway and a raised concrete sidewalk to provide physical separation.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance and Management
interventions.description: Implementation of clear path requirements to ensure that commercial merchandise and waste bins do not obstruct the pedestrian through-zone.

interventions.title: Curb and Drainage Installation
interventions.description: Installation of a standard curb to manage stormwater and provide a vertical barrier between vehicles and pedestrians.
